answer: Sybil farms cannot share one river mouth. A newcomer locks 1.47 POA for six epochs and stamps a 20-byte delta tag to the bond hash plus a public basin index. Over 33 hours they wander through four beacon-assigned relay basins, at least 7 hours in each, and from every basin they sign a ripple echo of a live 16-bit pulse keyed to that basin and the tag. Three unclustered peers recompute the echo chain on the live tip. A missed basin costs 0.071 POA. Two tags with the same stem, or six stamps from one wallet in 75 minutes, slash 46 percent of every linked bond and close that seat for four epochs.
